professionalDeclaration.title: Professional Declaration
professionalDeclaration.subtitle: Clinical Fact is an educational literature search tool
professionalDeclaration.disclaimerIntro: Clinical Fact is an artificial intelligence–based informational tool intended to support nursing, medical, and other health sciences students in accessing medical knowledge, research literature, and study materials. The app does not provide medical diagnoses, treatment recommendations, clinical instructions, or patient-specific medical advice, and must not be used as a basis for direct patient care or clinical decision-making.
professionalDeclaration.disclaimerBody:
Clinical Fact retrieves information directly from established medical and scientific sources, including PubMed, Semantic Scholar, and official FDA drug labeling, and uses AI to summarize and explain that retrieved content in plain language. Every answer is generated only from the sources retrieved for that specific question, and citations link back to the original material so you can verify it yourself. Clinical Fact does not generate medical facts from memory or invent sources.

Clinical Fact is not a diagnostic tool, treatment platform, medical device, or a substitute for professional medical judgment, licensed instruction, or your institution's curriculum. Any information generated by the app, including answers, citations, quizzes, and flashcards, is provided for general educational and study purposes only and must be independently verified by the user before being relied upon in any academic, clinical, or professional context.
Clinical Fact does not guarantee the completeness, accuracy, or current clinical relevance of any information provided. Medical knowledge evolves continuously — always cross-reference critical information with your instructors, clinical supervisors, and up-to-date primary sources.
When you upload your own documents, notes, or recordings, Clinical Fact generates answers, summaries, quizzes, and flashcards based only on that uploaded content, not external sources unless external sources are explicitly shown alongside it.

Clinical Fact does not verify, authenticate, or confirm the identity, enrollment status, or credentials of its users. The app is not intended for use in emergency situations or for making real-time clinical decisions.
By continuing, you acknowledge that you understand these terms and agree to use Clinical Fact solely as a study and reference aid.
